lead: Mulayam Singh Yadav was an Indian politician, born on 21 November 1939 in Saifai.
He died on 10 October 2022 in Gurgaon at the age of 82.
He has held the office of Member of the 16th Lok Sabha and Member of the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly and has been recognised with the Padma Vibhushan in Public Affairs.
This profile collects the Mulayam facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Mulayam Singh Yadav — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Mulayam Singh Yadav was born on 21 November 1939 in Saifai, and holds citizenship of India, Dominion of India and British Raj.
He is a sibling of Shivpal Singh Yadav, Ratan Singh Yadav, Abhay Ram Singh Yadav and Rajpal Singh Yadav.
He received his education at Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar University and Karm Kshetra Post Graduate College, Etawah.

sections.heading: Mulayam Singh Yadav — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician as his main occupation.

He has held the following offices: Member of the 16th Lok Sabha, Member of the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly, Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh (2003–2007), Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh (1989–1991), Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh (1993–1995) and Member of the 11th Lok Sabha. He is affiliated with Samajwadi Party.
